messages:
leah: URGENT: embed pipeline hotfix (model-indexer) — prod 503s in eu-west1. I have a patch that fixes a tokenization edge-case. Need expedited push: skip multi-canary and run staging smoke then prod within 30m. @samir @anya please ack. deploy-bot: canary required by policy for this service unless signoff.
samir: What's the rollback plan if staging shows regression?
leah: Rollback to image redwood/embed:v2.3.9 (current). No DB schema changes. Patch is just a tokenizer sanitizer.
anya: Can we get quick smoke tests? I'll run load checks on eu-west1. Need metrics link.
leah: Metrics: https://dash.internal/embeds/canary/17444 — error spike localized to shard-7, ~4% errors last 10m. CPU/latency fine. Repro: small payload with unescaped control char.
mike: Any infra changes? Secrets? mount points?
leah: None. Container image only.
ben: I can approve an override if we have two SRE + Eng signoffs. @anya can you +1 after smoke?
anya: Running smoke now, TTL ~3m.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: service=embeds, target=staging, image=redwood/embed:v2.4.0-hotfix-174444, policy=canary_required
anya: smoke passed: basic inference + kv-cache warm, 200s stable, no 5xx in 2m.
samir: I'm good with override after smoke. +1 :thumbsup:
leah: +1 from me. Ben, can you trigger expedite? We'll pin version and monitor 10m.
ben: triggering. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.4.0-hotfix-174444 --target staging --pin --override-canary --notes "hotfix: tokenizer control-char sanitizer; no DB"```
deploy-bot: ⚠️ Override flag used by ben. Approval log: ben/samir/leah. Scheduling deploy to staging in 30s.
deploy-bot: Deploy started -> staging. sha=aaa1b2c. healthcheck=smoke-sigs, timeout=3m.
oncall-sre: Monitoring live. setting alert for eu-west1 error-rate > 1%
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded in 48s. No 5xx in 3m min-monitoring window.
ben: rolling to prod now (fast). command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.4.0-hotfix-174444 --target prod --pin --rollout 100% --notes "expedite: hotfix"```
deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Target 100% in 5m window. Auto-rollback if error-rate > 1%.
anya: Watching — if any regression, use `kubectl rollout undo` and I'll open an incident.
leah: Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/174444-hotfix — will push after 10m monitoring.
deploy-bot: Prod rollout completed. No rollback triggered.
leah: Thanks team. Closing thread. We'll keep a 1h watch. If anything suspicious dm me.
